March 17th 1920. 19
REPORT ON Return of Ettinger.
Made by D. I. Givens Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer
Sir,
A. Ettinger and his wife arrived here by the
S. S. "Sakaki Maru" on 15th instant and are living at
No. 78 Bubbling Well Road, a boarding-house kept by
a Polish woman named Bertha Scholder.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I.
C. D. O.

关于埃廷格返回的报告。
由侦探督察吉文斯 (D. I. Givens) 撰写，经首席侦探官转呈

阁下，

A. 埃廷格及其妻子于本月15日乘“榊丸”号 (S. S. "Sakaki Maru") 抵达此处，现居住于静安寺路78号，该处为一名名为伯莎·肖尔德 (Bertha Scholder) 的波兰妇女经营的寄宿公寓。

Shanghai Municipal Police. 2929
16.8.19

Hongkew Station.
14th July 1919

REPORT ON A. Ettinger.

Made by D.I. Reeves. Forwarded by Chief Detective Officer.

Sir,

I beg to report that yesterday I interviewed Mrs. Ettinger, she has changed her address and now lives in 40 Nanzing Road. She informed me her husband was in Dairen and staying at the Yamato Hotel. He has a passport with his photograph attached and Mrs. Ettinger thinks it was issued by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs. It is not correct that he is employed by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs as reported to me by Kindler. Mrs. Ettinger informed me that her husband is trying to work up a tobacco and cigar business and took a lot of samples with him to Dairen. She stated also that her husband's passport has been visied by the Japanese Consulate and that he did leave by the Sakaki Maru on the 1st inst. Asked if she had telephoned to the Captain Superintendent, she stated that she had not, but immediately suggested that it must be Kindler and his wife. I think myself that Kindler and his wife are the people who telephoned. He telephoned to the station for me some time ago and the sergeant on duty informed me that the man who telephoned would not give his name, so I presumed it was Kindler and went to see him. He said it was him who telephoned and then told me a lot of news about 9 N. Szechuen Road which I paid very little attention to, knowing Kindler too well to pay and reliance on his information.

Mrs. Ettinger informed me that there is a prostitute in Shanghai who has been keeping Kindler for some years and now is going to take criminal action against him.

I am, Sir, Your obedient servant,
Chief Detective Officer.
Percy J. Reeves
D. I.

（左侧边缘手写批注：C.H.）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。 2929
16.8.19

虹口捕房。
1919年7月14日

关于 A. 埃廷格的报告。

由侦探督察里夫斯 (D.I. Reeves) 撰写。经首席侦探官转呈。

阁下，

谨此报告，昨日我会见了埃廷格夫人，她已变更住址，现居住于南京路40号。她告知我，其丈夫在大连，下榻于大和旅馆。他持有贴有照片的护照，埃廷格夫人认为该护照由外交部签发。金德勒 (Kindler) 此前向我报告称其受雇于外交部，此说法并不属实。埃廷格夫人告知我，其丈夫正试图拓展烟草与雪茄业务，并携带大量样品前往大连。她还表示，其丈夫的护照已由日本领事馆签证，且他确已于本月1日乘“榊丸”号离境。当被问及是否曾致电总监时，她表示并未致电，但随即暗示致电者必是金德勒及其妻子。我个人认为，致电者正是金德勒夫妇。前一段时间他曾替我致电捕房，值班警长告知我，致电者不愿透露姓名，因此我推测是金德勒并前去见他。他承认电话是他打的，随后向我讲述了许多关于北四川路9号的消息，但我未予重视，因为我太了解金德勒，深知其提供的信息不可靠。

埃廷格夫人告知我，上海有一名妓女多年来一直供养金德勒，现在正准备对他提起刑事诉讼。

此致，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
首席侦探官。
珀西·J. 里夫斯 (Percy J. Reeves)
侦探督察

（左侧边缘手写批注：C.H.）

Shanghai Municipal Police. 3929
169 8/9 19

Hongkew Station.
11th July 1919

REPORT ON A. Ettinger.

Made by D.I. Reeves. Forwarded by

Sir,

It was reported to me some time ago by "Kindler" that
A. Ettinger was in the employ of the Chinese Government, through
the Bureau of Foreign Affairs and his duty was to act as
messenger to convey documents between Russia and China.
Ettinger has recently been travelling between Shanghai and
Mukden by the Sakaki Maru for what purpose it cannot be
ascertained. He was there in the early part of June for 2
or 3 weeks and is said to have left again by the Sakaki Maru
on the 1st inst. It is now reported that he has a Chinese
passport which has been endorsed by the Japanese Consulate.
In examining the passenger list of the Sakaki Maru on the 1st
inst. his name does not appear in English, but there is no
doubt he left Shanghai by this steamer. It is alleged that he
left with Goldstien who lived at one time in the Palace Hotel
with Mendelson who is suspected by the Russian Authorities of
dealing in false rouble notes. Goldstien's name is amongst
those on the passenger list. I think that his visits to the
north are more likely to be as regards the smuggling of opium,
but it would be interesting to know whether the Bureau of
Foreign Affairs does employ him in some capacity and whether
they gave him a Chinese passport. The last time I heard of
Ettinger was that he was employed by a Persian firm Namazee &
Co. but the Russian Consulate I hear told the firm they would be
put on the Black List if they continued to employ him, and he
was sent off in consequence.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Geo. J. Reeves.
D. I.
Chief Detective Officer.

虹口捕房。
1919年7月11日

关于 A. 埃廷格的报告。

由侦探督察里夫斯 (D.I. Reeves) 撰写。经

阁下，

不久前，“金德勒” (Kindler) 向我报告称，
A. 埃廷格受雇于中国政府，隶属外交部，其职责是担任信使，在中俄之间传递文件。
埃廷格近期乘“榊丸”号往返于上海与奉天之间，其目的尚无法查明。他在六月上旬曾在那里停留两至三周，据称又于本月1日乘“榊丸”号离开。现有报告称，他持有一本经日本领事馆签注的中国护照。在查阅本月1日“榊丸”号的乘客名单时，未发现其英文姓名，但毫无疑问他是乘该轮离开上海的。据称，他是与戈尔德斯坦 (Goldstien) 一同离开的，戈尔德斯坦曾与门德尔松 (Mendelson) 同住于汇中饭店，后者被俄国当局怀疑从事伪造卢布钞票的交易。戈尔德斯坦的名字在乘客名单之中。我认为，他前往北方更可能是为了走私鸦片，但若能查明外交部是否以某种身份雇用他，以及是否向他发放了中国护照，将颇有意思。我上次听到关于埃廷格的消息是，他受雇于一家波斯商行纳马齐公司 (Namazee & Co.)，但我听说俄国领事馆告知该行，若继续雇用他，将其列入黑名单，因此他被解雇。

此致，
阁下，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
乔治·J. 里夫斯 (Geo. J. Reeves)。
侦探督察
首席侦探官。
